lead.description: the quantity that a measurement or an estimate is trying to recover

overview_sentence: The [true value](articles/true-value.qmd) is the quantity a measurement or an estimate is trying to recover.

self_checks.title: Error of the mean
self_checks.prompt: Estimates 48, 53, and 51 are made of a true mass of 50. What is the error of their mean?
self_checks.answer: The mean is 152/3 and the error is 2/3.

self_checks.title: Fourth estimate
self_checks.prompt: A fourth estimate of 48 is added, and the true mass stays 50. What is the error of the new mean?
self_checks.answer: The mean is 50 and the error is 0.
